在钟楼邮局分拣来信，让两位快递员穿梭于天文台、花园和炉火工坊。原创分层小世界变成: Sort incoming letters in the clock-tower post office, sending two couriers between an observatory, a garden and a hearth workshop. Original layered little worlds become an editable native game, then an actual first delivery is edited into a short film.
用真实跨软件制作连接原画、游戏逻辑与影片：画面里的小世界承担实际投递目的地，保存: Connect original artwork, game logic and film through real cross-application production: the little worlds in the images serve as actual delivery destinations, editable native projects are saved, and the first-delivery film is clearly distinguished from full-game acceptance checks.
通过 GIMP MCP 绘制分层邮局、Lumen 天文台、Moss 花园与 Em: Use GIMP MCP to paint a layered post office, Lumen observatory, Moss garden and Ember hearth workshop at 768 × 768, with a consistent paper color and deep-blue outlines; retain transparency, layers and editable XCF files. Use Godot MCP to connect relative resources to three delivery routes and two couriers, supporting letter reading, route selection, dispatch within the time window, returns and restamping after late delivery, plus pause, restart and keyboard focus. Separately verify a full eight-letter shift through native state and completion frames. Use Kdenlive MCP to edit the station artwork, actual first-delivery footage and editable text into a seven-second film at 1280 × 720 / 30 fps; save relative media, reopen and re-export, and verify the finished film. Record failures, and do not use the short film as a substitute for full-game verification.
